rationale: The Latin anchors *sculpere* (to carve/engrave) and *delineare* (to trace/draw outlines), together with the co-text referencing an image of the Lord painted/depicted on a panel (*imaginem … in tabula depictam*), firmly point to the physical act of tracing or drawing a shape. Among the candidates, *delineate.v.03* ("trace the shape of") best captures this concrete, graphic sense of marking or inscribing outlines, as opposed to the more abstract or descriptive senses.
